== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tyrant (Japanese)|Tyrant]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/170462286/e9DZ7SyhWk-yv77bjffLSw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 170462286.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d6520cb026a3e6917efc0485e1a417168bc6991b465737b11b21f98c87a97f1f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
